say:1:1030235001:0.text: Our grapes went from a hot commodity to something no one wanted overnight. I heard it could cause illness... No worth now.
say:1:1030235001:0.source_cn: 一夜之间，我们种的葡萄都没人收购了，听说吃了的人还会生...
say:1:1030235001:0.male: Our grapes went from a hot commodity to something no one wanted overnight. I heard it could cause illness... No worth now.
say:1:1030235001:0.female: Our grapes went from a hot commodity to something no one wanted overnight. I heard it could cause illness... No worth now.

say:2:1030235002:0.text: Are we going back to the miserable days of growing wheat?
say:2:1030235002:0.source_cn: 难道要重回耕种小麦的穷苦日子了吗？
